# Handlyr — NYC Handyman Service (Full Reference)

> Handlyr is a professional, owner-operated handyman service in New York City,
> serving Brooklyn, Queens, and Manhasset. Owner-operated by Serge with 15+ years
> of hands-on experience (in business since 2009). Free estimates, flat upfront
> pricing, fast response, clean work.

## Contact & Booking
- Phone / Text: (347) 799-8402
- Email: order@handlyr.org
- Website: https://handlyr.org
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM. Same-day appointments often available.
- Booking: Text a photo of the job to (347) 799-8402. We reply with a clear,
  upfront estimate, usually within the hour. Estimates are free and no-obligation.

## Service Areas

### Brooklyn, NY — https://handlyr.org/service-areas/brooklyn
Neighborhoods: Park Slope, Williamsburg, DUMBO, Bay Ridge, Flatbush, Crown
Heights, Bed-Stuy, Sunset Park. Experienced with pre-war plaster walls, concrete
ceilings in new construction, narrow hallways, and tight staircases.

### Queens, NY — https://handlyr.org/service-areas/queens
Neighborhoods: Long Island City, Astoria, Sunnyside, Forest Hills, Flushing,
Jackson Heights, Jamaica, Bayside. New high-rises, classic co-ops, and
single-family homes — familiar with building access, parking, and wall types.

### Manhasset, NY — https://handlyr.org/service-areas/manhasset
Neighborhoods: Manhasset, Plandome, Munsey Park, Flower Hill, Strathmore,
Manhasset Hills (North Shore of Nassau County). NYC-grade craftsmanship for
single-family homes and estates.

## Services (detail)

### Furniture Assembly — https://handlyr.org/services/furniture-assembly
IKEA, Wayfair, West Elm, Amazon, CB2 and all flat-pack brands. Hardware sorted
and verified before assembly, manufacturer sequence followed, every connection
checked for stability, packaging removed, furniture positioned where you want it.
Single items or full-apartment moves in one visit.

### TV Mounting — https://handlyr.org/services/tv-mounting
All wall types: drywall with studs, concrete, brick, tile, and pre-war plaster.
Correct anchors for each wall. Cable management included (in-wall, behind molding,
or clean surface raceway). Handles single TVs up to 85"+, soundbars, and full home
theater setups. Level verified before and after; TV tested at preferred height.

### Shelf Installation — https://handlyr.org/services/shelf-installation
Floating shelves, bracket shelves, wall bookcases, and modular systems (IKEA
KALLAX, Billy). Masonry anchors for concrete, studs/toggles for drywall. Height
and spacing confirmed before drilling; every shelf leveled and load-tested.

### Blinds & Window Treatment Installation — https://handlyr.org/services/blinds-installation
Roller shades, cellular shades, venetian blinds, roman shades, curtain rods and
tracks. Inside- and outside-mount, all materials and window types. Renter-friendly
installs that can be removed cleanly; level, tight, smooth operation.

### Cabinet Installation — https://handlyr.org/services/cabinet-installation
Kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, medicine cabinets, and storage/closet
systems. Anchored to wall structure, shimmed level and plumb, doors and drawers
adjusted for smooth operation. Minor adjustments to existing cabinets too.

### Drywall Repair — https://handlyr.org/services/drywall-repair
Doorknob holes, old-mount patches, water damage, and full-section replacement.
Mesh/backing for larger holes, multiple compound coats sanded smooth, texture
matched (smooth, orange peel, knockdown). Paint-ready finish. Popular with renters
patching before move-out inspections.

### General Handyman Repairs — https://handlyr.org/services/general-repairs
Door and window hardware, minor plumbing (fixture replacement, shutoff valves,
supply lines), light fixture swaps, outlet covers, picture/mirror hanging, and
long punch lists. One visit, multiple items. Honest advice if a specialist is
needed instead.

## Pricing
- Free, no-obligation estimates. Flat, upfront pricing quoted before work begins.
  No hidden fees.
- (Per-service starting prices to be added once confirmed.)

## What to Expect / Process
1. Text a photo and short description of the job to (347) 799-8402.
2. Receive a clear, upfront estimate (usually within the hour).
3. Schedule a visit — same-day often available, hours 8 AM–8 PM daily.
4. We arrive on time, protect floors and furniture, do the work, and clean up.
